title: Figure Two: Color-coded electromagnetic spectrum chart - frequency, wavelength, energy
description: Chart labeled 'Figure Two' with source link 'http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electromagnetic_spectrum#cite_note-1', showing a color-coded vertical bar of spectrum classes from gamma rays down to ELF alongside columns for frequency (300 EHz to 3 Hz), wavelength (1 pm to 100 Mm) and energy (1.24 MeV to 12.4 feV). A key below defines abbreviations such as 'HX= Hard X-Rays', 'EHF= Extremely High Frequency' and 'ELF= Extremely Low Frequency'. Text below cites the 2007 'Bioinitiative Report' on non-thermal RF effects.
